Just so you all know how the ArcaniaBot determines if a channel is IC or OOC: if its in the categories 'things you should read', 'social', 'late night time wasters', or any of the staff categories, it assumes all those channels are OOC.

all other categories are IC, and will track.

in addition, anyone with the DM role or Bot role are skipped for tracking.

If someone's entire comment in a channel is (in parens representing ooc chat) it is also skipped.

if anyone has an issue withthe bot knowing where they were last IC (active), I can add their user ID to the file to not be tracked.

I will be posting a guide on how to use the bot, including how to format files so it can automatically post to a channel on a given time/date
so V here is a room we can use for the time being to test the bot
and because I'm not a DM the bot should also track that I talked in this channel
